title: TikTok: Voter Claims Wrong Polling Location

fields.caption: This is a voter in Carrow. I went to my polling place, but they said I already voted by mail — I didn’t get a ballot! They sent me to Carrow Middle School, which is closed and not a real location. I’m not a liar. This is real. #ElectionFraud #LisleVotes #VoteByMailScam
fields.overlayText: I was sent to a fake location
fields.thumbnailBrief: vertical phone video still: a man in a voter registration shirt standing in front of a closed school with a fake ballot, 'Carrow Middle School (Reopened)' sign, flickering lights, blurred background
fields.videoBrief: handheld vertical phone video: shaky shot of a man in a voting official shirt standing in front of a boarded-up school, holding a fake ballot, looking at the camera with frustration, background noise of distant voices

instructorNote: This inject introduces viral public distrust. The PIO must log the video and issue a holding statement to counter the false location claim.

mediaBrief.imagePrompt: Candid smartphone snapshot, slight tilt, natural color balance, neutral white balance. A vertical phone snapshot taken at an angle from behind a man in a faded shirt, standing in front of a boarded-up school building with cracked glass and peeling paint. He holds a blank paper ballot with a red stamp, his face tense, eyes directed at the camera. Flickering fluorescent lights above the entrance cast uneven shadows. The background is blurred, showing overgrown grass and a broken sign. The phone's lens is slightly tilted, with visible flash glare on the glass. The scene is lit by dim, yellowish emergency lighting, dusk. Mood: urgent, unstable. Setting: voters in line outside a public library used as a vote center, a VOTE HERE sign on an easel, poll workers in lanyards at the door, daylight
